community_list_entries.name: StratMem-Bench: Evaluating Strategic Memory Use in Virtual Character Conversation Beyond Factual Recall

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Benchmark (ACL 2026) of 657 single-turn character-dialogue instances derived from LoCoMo. Memory pools come from earlier sessions and mix required, supportive and irrelevant items, to score strategic memory use rather than recall.
